versions.changelog:
Initial release of create-video skill:

- Generates vertical videos from either audio files or text (with TTS synthesis).
- Automates project directory creation and manages input assets.
- Supports merging audio with background video templates using ffmpeg.
- Provides automatic content analysis outputs for TTS cases.
- Requires ffmpeg/ffprobe and (for TTS) ListenHub MCP Server.
- Organizes outputs in timestamped folders for easy management.
